SELECT
	SalesMan=SM.Name,
	AreaCount = COUNT(DISTINCT S.AreaCode),
	InvoiceCount=COUNT(DISTINCT S.SaleInvCode),
	SaleValue=SUM(S.NetAmt), 
	SaleDiscount = SUM(S.Discount),
	ReceivedOnInv=SUM(S.ReceivedOnInv),
	ReturnAmt = ISNULL(SUM(SR.Amt), 0),
	ReturnAllocationAmt = ISNULL(SUM(SRA.Amt), 0),
	ChequesReceived = ISNULL(SUM(Chq.Amt), 0),
	Debits = ISNULL(SUM(Debits.Amt), 0),
	Credits = ISNULL(SUM(Credits.Amt), 0),
	OtherCr = ISNULL(OldCr.OldCredits, 0),
	Balance=SUM(S.NetAmt) - SUM(S.ReceivedOnInv) - ISNULL(SUM(SRA.Amt), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Chq.Amt), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Credits.Amt), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(Debits.Amt), 0),
	OldBalance = ISNULL(OldCr.OldBalance, 0)
FROM
	SalesMan SM
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT 
		SS.SaleInvCode, 
		C.AreaCode,
		SS.SManCode, 
		NetAmt=ISNULL(SS.InvTotal, 0), 
    		Discount= Round(SUM (SD.looseqty * SD.itemflatdisc), 2) +
			Round(SUM(SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * SD.discperc * .01), 2) +
			Round(Sum(SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01)) * SS.discperc * 0.01, 2) + SS.FlatDisc, 
		ReceivedOnInv= 
			ISNULL(SUM(SS.Amt), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM(SS.CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=SS.SaleInvCode), 0)
	FROM SaleLedger SS, SaleDetail SD, Customer C
	WHERE 
		SS.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SS.Marked='N' AND
		SS.SaleCatCode IN (2) AND
		SS.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
		SS.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode
	GROUP BY SS.SaleInvCode, SS.SManCode, C.AreaCode, SS.InvTotal, SS.DiscPerc, SS.FlatDisc) AS S ON (SM.SalesManCode = S.SManCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT 
		SR.SaleInvCode, Amt=ISNULL(SUM(SR.InvTotal) , 0)
	FROM 
		SRLedger SR
	WHERE
		SR.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		SR.SaleInvCode IN 
			(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
			WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
				S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY SR.SaleInvCode) AS SR ON (S.SaleInvCode= SR.SaleInvCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT 
		D.SaleInvCode, Amt=ISNULL(SUM(D.Amt) , 0)
	FROM 
		SRAllocationdetail D, SRAllocationHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		H.SRAllocationCode = D.SRAllocationCode AND
		D.SaleInvCode IN 
			(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
			WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
				S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.SaleInvCode) AS SRA ON (S.SaleInvCode= SRA.SaleInvCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(D.Amt) 
	FROM NotesDetail D, Notes H 
	WHERE  
		H.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		H.NoteCatCode=1 AND H.NoteCode = D.NoteCode AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
			WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
				S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Chq ON (S.SaleInvCode= Chq.InvoiceCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(debit) 
	FROM GLDetail D, GLHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
		H.VochCatCode IN 
			(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
			WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1) AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
			WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
				S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Debits ON (S.SaleInvCode= Debits.InvoiceCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(credit)
	FROM GLDetail D, GLHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
		H.VochCatCode IN 
			(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
			WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1) AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
			WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
				S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Credits ON (S.SaleInvCode= Credits.InvoiceCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT SalesManCode=MS.SManCode, OldCredits=SUM(D.Credit), OldBalance = SUM(MS.Balance)
	FROM 
		GLHeader H, GLDetail D,
		(SELECT SL.SaleInvCode, SL.SmanCode, Balance=SL.Outstandingamt 
		FROM SaleLedger SL 
		WHERE SL.AccountFor = 'Y' AND SL.Marked='N' AND SL.SaleCatCode IN (2) AND
			SL.SaleInvCode NOT IN
				(SELECT S1.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S1 
				WHERE S1.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
					S1.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S1.Marked='N' AND	S1.SaleCatCode IN (2))) MS
	WHERE
		H.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND 
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
		H.VochCatCode IN 
			(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1) AND 
		D.InvoiceCode = MS.SaleInvCode 
	GROUP BY MS.SManCode) AS OldCr ON (SM.SalesManCode = OldCr.SalesManCode)
GROUP BY SM.Name, OldCr.OldCredits, OldCr.OldBalance
